reviews.shade: TOCOBO Bio Watery Sun Cream Special Set (50mL+10mL*2ea) SPF50 PA++++
reviews.text:
I love the finish, the scent was pleasant, as well. This just burned my eyes without even sweating! Just being applied near them irritated them so bad.

I dont not like to have to have different products like SPF for different areas, so this did not fit the bill. A few closed comodones appeared on my forehead. My skin was just not a fan and I wanted to like it :( 

I am glad they had this set with smaller tubes so I could try those and not waste the full size product so I can gift it to someone else. I thought this was perfect for sensitive skin and had good ingredients with praise.
reviews.zh:
我好鍾意完成效果，味道都好好聞。佢未出汗，已經令我雙眼刺痛！只係喺眼附近塗咗都刺激到我雙眼，好辛苦。

我唔鍾意要為唔同部位用唔同嘅防曬產品，所以呢款唔啱我嘅要求。我額頭出現咗幾粒閉口。我嘅皮膚就係唔太接受，我本來想鍾意佢嘅 :(

我好開心佢哋有呢套細支裝，咁我可以試吓細支裝，唔使浪費正裝，之後仲可以送畀其他人。我本來以為呢款好啱敏感皮膚，成分好，亦都獲好評。

reviews.shade: TOCOBO Bio Watery Sun Cream Special Set (50mL+10mL*2ea) SPF50 PA++++
reviews.text: I've tried lots of different sunscreens, but the Tocobo Watery Sun Cream is the lightest and least oily. I'm very prone to breakouts from sunscreen but that doesn't seem to happen with this one. Has a very light, almost herbal scent, but the scent doesn't last long and isn't bothersome.
reviews.zh: 我試過好多唔同嘅防曬，但係 Tocobo Watery Sun Cream 係最輕盈、最唔油嘅一款。我好易因防曬而長暗瘡，但係用呢款就冇發生。有好淡、近乎草本嘅香味，但係香味唔會持久，亦唔會令人困擾。

reviews.shade: TOCOBO Bio Watery Sun Cream Special Set (50mL+10mL*2ea) SPF50 PA++++
reviews.text: The texture is very lightweight, more like a watery lotion or serum than a thick cream. It spreads easily and absorbs fairly quickly. If you want a daily sunscreen that feels light, offers strong protection, doesn’t leave a white cast, and comes in a handy set, this is a good choice. For those with sensitive or very dry skin, test around eyes and maybe use more moisturizing skincare alongside.
reviews.zh: 質地好輕盈，比較似水狀乳液或者精華，而唔係厚身嘅膏霜。好容易推開，吸收都幾快。如果你想要一款日常防曬，塗落感覺輕盈、防護力強、唔留白，而且有方便嘅套裝，呢款就係好選擇。對於敏感或者非常乾燥嘅皮膚，就要喺眼周測試吓，並且可能要配合更多保濕護膚產品一齊用。

reviews.shade: TOCOBO Bio Watery Sun Cream Special Set (50mL+10mL*2ea) SPF50 PA++++
reviews.text: I absolutely love the TOCOBO Bio Watery Sun Cream! The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and leaves no white cast — perfect for everyday use. I was so happy to get not just the full-size tube but also two 10mL minis, which are super convenient for travel or keeping in my bag. Such a great value for a product I use and love daily!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意 TOCOBO Bio Watery Sun Cream！質地輕盈，吸收快，冇白色殘留，日常使用非常啱。我好開心唔單止有正裝，仲有兩支 10mL 嘅細裝，方便旅行或者放喺袋入面。我每日都用、而且好鍾意嘅產品，真係好抵！

reviews.shade: TOCOBO Bio Watery Sun Cream Special Set (50mL+10mL*2ea) SPF50 PA++++
reviews.text: I loved this product and have purchased it many times. It's very light and hydrating and has a glowy finish. I think if you have oily skin you might not like it. It also has a strongish botanical smell, not really floral just planty, that I like but could be overpowering if you're sensitive to smells. it sits very nice under makeup.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款產品，已經買過好多次。佢好輕盈、保濕，而且有亮澤嘅效果。我諗如果你係油性皮膚，可能唔會鍾意。佢有少少濃嘅植物香，唔係花香，更似植物嘅味道，我好鍾意，但係如果你對味道敏感，可能會覺得太搶。佢疊喺妝下面都好服貼。

reviews.shade: TOCOBO Bio Watery Sun Cream Special Set (50mL+10mL*2ea) SPF50 PA++++
reviews.text: my all time favorite Korean sunscreen. I love the smells, the texture the way it blends in. it is all perfect. the sun protection is amazing as well. this set is very nice as well i was able to take my sunscreen with me on vacation with the small bottles and i left my big one at home.
reviews.zh: 我一直最鍾意嘅韓國防曬。我好鍾意佢嘅味道、質地，同埋推開嘅方式。一切都好完美。防曬效果亦都好驚人。呢套裝都好好，我用細裝瓶帶咗防曬去旅行，大支嗰支就留喺屋企。

reviews.shade: TOCOBO Bio Watery Sun Cream Special Set (50mL+10mL*2ea) SPF50 PA++++
reviews.text: Well I bought was in sale but I find it a bit sticky although maybe someone with dry complexion will fit much better but advantages it’s very practical to carry on and pretty light moisturizer and u don’t feel it much not a heavy sensation makes it much better although prefer maybe something not to sticky but good product in general still first day of purchase so I will wait see if is good to repurchase
reviews.zh: 我係減價時買嘅，但係我覺得有少少黏，不過或者乾性膚質嘅人會更合適。優點係好方便攜帶，亦係頗輕嘅保濕產品，塗咗之後你唔會覺得太重，呢點令佢好多；雖然我可能會更鍾意唔咁黏嘅嘢，但整體嚟講係好產品。依家先買咗第一日，所以我會等睇下值唔值得再買。

reviews.shade: TOCOBO Bio Watery Sun Cream Special Set (50mL+10mL*2ea) SPF50 PA++++
reviews.text: Was looking for a lightweight but still full protection sunscreen and this pretty much covers all basis. The only things that did not please me was the smell of it… it felt like I was putting chlorine on my face. As it’s a chemical sunscreen I expected a bit of burn since my skin is pretty sensitive. Which did happen around the eye area (lids and cheeks). Otherwise the texture is great, smooth and not sticky, really easy to spread as well. Packaging is really small and compact. The squirt bottle makes it easier to control the amount used as well.
reviews.zh: 我一直想搵一款輕盈但防護力又足夠嘅防曬，呢款基本上都做到晒。唯一令我唔滿意嘅係佢嘅味道……感覺好似喺面上塗咗氯咁。因為佢係化學防曬，我預期會有少少刺痛，因為我嘅皮膚都幾敏感。果然喺眼周位置（眼皮同面頰）有刺痛感。除此之外，質地都好好，順滑、唔黏，亦都好容易推開。包裝好細、好緊湊。擠壓瓶都令我更容易控制用量。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
